db_path.description: Path to the conference schedule SQLite database. If empty, defaults to ~/.local/share/Toastfreeware/ConfClerk/ConfClerk.sqlite (Qt5) or ~/.local/share/data/Toastfreeware/ConfClerk/ConfClerk.sqlite (Qt4).

auto_reload.description: Whether to automatically reload the database when it changes on disk.

favorites_only.description: Whether to show only favorite events in the main schedule view.

import_urls.description: List of URLs (file:// or http(s)://) to conference schedule XML files to import at startup. One per line in the config file.
